title: fix(fields): an untyped repeater edits its stored rows as JSON in the record form
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTEnFfLftKLAV7Uqry9LwhD)_

Fixes #29177

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对象上的 `repeater` 字段（无类型 JSON 数组）在记录编辑表单里改用 JSON 编辑器显示和编辑，与旁边的 `composite`、`record` 一致；原来走的是明细行网格，没有列，只画出编号行。
- 为什么改：网格只画声明过的列，而 spec 规定 repeater 没有列，所以已存的 `[{label:'one',qty:1},…]` 在表单里看不到、也改不了。另一条路（按行的键推导列）实测会把 `qty` 存成字符串 `"5"`、把嵌套对象显示为 `[object Object]`，会丢数据，所以没选。
- 风险与回滚：只改别名表一行；repeater 在记录表单和 Studio 表单画布上不再占满整行（JSON 编辑器是普通宽度，与 composite 相同）。声明了列的明细行网格不变；行内编辑本来就排除 repeater，仍然排除。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/fields/src/field-type-alias.ts`（`repeater` 那一行），`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.untypedRepeater.test.tsx`，`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx`（宽度用例改指向）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.untypedRepeater.test.tsx`，预期 4 个用例全绿；或在 showcase 的 Field Zoo「Specimen — Full」点 Edit，看到 "Repeater (embedded array)" 显示两行 JSON。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@objectstack/spec` declares `repeater` an untyped array of embedded JSON objects: `FieldSchema` has no sub-field or column member, the strict field schema refuses `columns` on it by name, and the `field/embedded-sub-fields` lint reports one. The form's alias table (`mapFieldTypeToFormType` in `ui/packages/fields/src/field-type-alias.ts`) still sent it to the line-items grid (`field:grid`). `GridField` draws only declared columns (`allColumns = cfg.columns || []`), so a stored repeater showed numbered rows with Duplicate and Remove and no cell, and Add line appended an empty object.

The one table row changes: `repeater: 'field:grid'` becomes `repeater: 'field:object'`, the JSON editor (`ObjectField`) that `composite`, `record` and `json` already use. The edit form now shows the stored array as pretty-printed JSON, an edit saves an array of objects (never a string), and unparsable text is refused before the save. `GridField.tsx` is not touched.

**Why the JSON editor and not derived columns.** The card offered both, and both were measured. Driving `GridField` with columns derived from the row keys (the shape a derived-columns fix would hand it) on rows `{label:'one',qty:1,meta:{color:'red'}}` and `{label:'two',qty:2,extra:true}`: the `meta` cell read `[object Object]`, the `extra` cell read the text `true`, and changing the `qty` cell to 5 emitted `qty: "5"`, a string. A derived grid therefore loses edits (type drift on every touched cell) or has to be read-only, and either way cannot show nested values. The JSON editor round-trips any value the spec allows, and it is the face the other two untyped containers already have, so the three behave alike.

**What else moves, by consequence.**

- Layout: `field:grid` is in the form's `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES`, `field:object` is not. A repeater is now laid out at normal width in the record form and on the Studio form canvas, like `composite`. The canvas resolves width through the same alias table, so the two still agree. `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx` case "spans a repeater field full-row" pinned the old width; it is repointed to assert the canvas matches the runtime resolution (`field:object`, not full-row). The seat accepted this file before it was edited.
- Inline editing: unchanged. `repeater` stays excluded (`object` and `grid` are both in `INLINE_EXCLUDED_FIELD_TYPES`); `FieldEditWidget.test.ts` "the structured/computed spec spellings are closed corruption paths" is green unchanged.
- Read side: unchanged. Record detail and the list cell (`RepeaterCellRenderer`, the row count) do not read the form alias.
- A comment in `autoLayout.wideSpelling.test.ts` that described the repeater/grid width asymmetry as open is updated; that asymmetry no longer exists.

**Repeaters that declare columns.** None exist to lose their grid: `git grep` for `type: 'repeater'` across the repo (examples, showcase, apps, tests, docs) and `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` found no object field that declares `columns`. The only hit carrying `columns` is the lint test that proves such a field is refused. The metadata-form `repeater` rows in `packages/spec/src/**/*.form.ts` are a different surface (Studio's `SchemaForm` `RepeaterField`), which does not read this alias table.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.untypedRepeater.test.tsx`, driven through the record Edit dialog (`ModalForm`, real registered widgets, a click on the real Update button), with the card's value `[{label:'one',qty:1},{label:'two',qty:2}]` and no columns:
  1. the field shows "one", "two", 1 and 2, and no line-items grid;
  2. an edit saves `f_repeater` as an array of objects with numeric `qty`, never a string;
  3. an untouched save never writes the field as text;
  4. control: a line-items grid that declares its columns still draws one input per column and writes a typed cell (`qty: 4`).
- `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx`: the repeater width case is repointed as above.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ablation.** Restoring `repeater: 'field:grid'` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 -> 0) turned cases 1-3 red; the control stayed green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Real browser, showcase field zoo: MEASURED.** Fresh showcase backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) plus the Console Vite dev server on source, "Specimen — Full", Edit. With the alias row reverted: a full-width grid with header "#", rows 1 and 2 with Duplicate and Remove, a ghost row 3, Add line, no cell content. With this change: the field shows the two rows as JSON beside the composite and record editors; replacing the text with `[{"label":"one","qty":5},{"label":"three","qty":3}]` and clicking Update stored exactly that array of objects (read back through `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_field_zoo/ID`). Screenshots are kept with the card thread.
- **No spec change.** The untyped shape stands as ruled on #25681.
